mechanism: Both drugs can cause hematologic toxicity and gastrointestinal effects; primaquine induces hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients while clindamycin increases this risk through additive bone marrow suppression and GI irritation.
action: Screen for G6PD deficiency before primaquine use; monitor CBC and hemoglobin; consider alternative antimalarial if concurrent use unavoidable; monitor for signs of hemolysis and gastrointestinal distress.
